posts.title: 🎬 Sicario
posts.description: This is exquisitely well made. Loved the images, loved the acting. The soundtrack is so good. And all those missions are super suspenseful and their action is also perfect (and absolutely ruthless). But it’s such a serious and tragic movie. And I’m not always in the mood for this. But this still gets my recommendation. 👍 Recommended!
